status.pending: scheduled, waiting for the send window.
status.sending: claimed by the delivery worker right now.
status.sent: accepted by Gmail for your verified email.
status.failedApiDisabled: could not send: the Gmail API is disabled in Google Cloud Console (gmail_api_disabled); enable it and resend manually.
status.failed: could not send{{codeNote}}; the system does not retry automatically.
status.deliveryUnknown: terminal state: Gmail does not guarantee single delivery and the response was lost or the lease expired{{codeNote}}. It is not retried automatically; resending creates a new occurrence and may duplicate the email.
status.cancelled: cancelled by a change of date, preference or task status.
